Record Class DataKey

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.jwcarman.codec.crypto.DataKey
Record Components:
keyId - the id of the KEK that wrapped this key; 1..65535 UTF-8 bytes
key - the plaintext data-encryption key
wrapped - the wrapped (ciphertext) form of key; 1..65535 bytes, defensively cloned on construction and by wrapped()
public record DataKey(String keyId, SecretKey key, byte[] wrapped) extends Record
A data-encryption key (DEK) acquired from a DataKeyProvider: the plaintext key material used to encrypt or decrypt one message, paired with the id of the key-encryption key (KEK) that wrapped it and the wrapped (ciphertext) form of the key itself.

keyId travels in cleartext in every message and identifies which KEK wrapped was produced under; key is the plaintext DEK, held only in memory and never persisted or transmitted; wrapped is the DEK encrypted under that KEK, carried alongside the ciphertext so decode can recover key without a second key-generation call.

equals/hashCode deliberately compare only keyId and wrapped, ignoring key: two DataKey instances that wrap the same bytes under the same KEK are the same data key for identity purposes, even if key is a distinct SecretKey object (as, for example, two separate unwrap calls on the same wrapped bytes would produce) — comparing raw key material would also risk timing side channels and adds no information beyond what wrapped already encodes.
